description: Sealed bonds from the Affine.Earth corpus (GAIA_SPATIAL_BOND_WIRES). mined_from is LLM_WEIGHTS or LLVM_IR. Stateless: pin at_seq to make the read reproducible across cells, or omit it to read the moving head.

at_seq.description: decimal string, caller-pinned stream position; same value = same bytes. e.g. 1

limit.description: decimal string, rows up to 8192; JSON numbers still admitted. e.g. 64

sector.description: hex sector prefix: the four hex digits of the top 16 bits of a bond's Morton key, e.g. 0a3f

name: corpus_bonds
